bio: Richard Ray Brattin Jr. (born July 22, 1980) is an American politician serving as a Republican state senator from Missouri, representing the 31st district, composing of Cass, Bates, Barton, Henry, and Vernon counties. He is a former state representative, having served three terms in the Missouri House of Representatives.
offices: Member of the Missouri House of Representatives (2011–2019)
Member of the State Senate of Missouri (2021–present)
